meta.name: migrate-from-openclaw
meta.description: Migrate from OpenClaw to NanoClaw v2. Detects an existing OpenClaw installation, extracts identity, channel credentials, scheduled tasks, and other config, then guides interactive migration. Triggers on "migrate from openclaw", "openclaw migration", "import from openclaw".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将 OpenClaw 配置迁移到 NanoClaw v2
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在从 OpenClaw 迁移到 NanoClaw v2
copy.tagline_en: Migrate your OpenClaw configuration to NanoClaw v2
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are migrating from OpenClaw to NanoClaw v2

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会带你一步步把 OpenClaw 里的身份、聊天频道、定时任务、设置和记忆搬到 NanoClaw v2;迁移前先读取并和你商量,确认要搬什么、放哪里,凭据显示时打码。
howto.when: 当你说出“migrate from openclaw”“import from openclaw”等关键词,或要求从 OpenClaw 迁移到 NanoClaw 时触发。

say.text: 帮我从 OpenClaw 迁移到 NanoClaw,先看看有哪些配置。
say.note: 发现安装后会先展示迁移概要。

say.text: 把 Telegram 群聊和定时任务迁过去,身份保持共享。
say.note: 会询问共享还是分开,再逐步执行。

say.text: 迁移前先展示要改的地方,确认后再动手。
say.note: 每个阶段都会先征得你同意才应用。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude guides you through migrating an OpenClaw install into NanoClaw v2: it reads identity, credentials, scheduled tasks and config, discusses with you what to carry over, proposes changes, then applies them in phases. Credentials are masked when displayed.
howto.when_en: Triggers on phrases like 'migrate from openclaw', 'openclaw migration', 'import from openclaw', or any request to import from OpenClaw.

say_en.text: Help me migrate from OpenClaw to NanoClaw, show what config exists first.
say_en.note: Discovers install and summarizes before starting.

say_en.text: Migrate my Telegram groups and scheduled tasks, keep shared identity.
say_en.note: Asks shared vs separate, then proceeds step by step.

say_en.text: Show proposed changes before applying anything.
say_en.note: Each phase gets your confirmation first.
